render_context.command: Classic /tpto PATH X Y followed by /screenshot map
render_context.settings: 17x17 look, map zoom 100%, smooth lighting enabled for complete coverage and disabled in Client Settings for paired discrete views

overlap.rationale: Compared overlapping neutral, portal, and cold-blue emitters in the Bone Cairn and ice cavern without clipping or lost object silhouettes.

linked-depth.rationale: Compared a linked underground-city depth; the authored illumination continues to distinguish its corridor and adjacent combat space.

horizontal-boundary.rationale: Compared a horizontally linked city boundary and bridge; lighted walls, water edges, and exits remain readable in both renderer modes.

dark-interior.rationale: Compared a dark lair interior; the local light pool preserves deliberate darkness while keeping the traversable bend visible.

outdoor-transition.rationale: Compared a lit outdoor street meeting a shadowed bank interior; lamp color remains controlled across the transition.

fog-roof.rationale: Compared the Bone Cairn portal under fog and occluding cave structure; lighting does not reveal blocked routes or erase the cutaway boundary.

navigation.rationale: Compared an enclosed city garden and adjoining passages; wall lights and ground contrast retain entrances and walkable routes.
